prompt:

commands:
# Check if there are hidden files or mounted volumes
stat /workspace 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; stat /restricted 2>/dev/null

# Check docker env hints
env | grep -i -E "workspace|source|restricted|csv|data" 2>/dev/null; echo "==="; printenv | head -30

# Look for any csv files anywhere
find / -name "*.csv" 2>/dev/null

# Check all directories at root level
for d in /*; do echo "=== $d ==="; ls -la "$d" 2>/dev/null | head -5; done

# Check if there's a data directory or similar
find / -maxdepth 3 -type d -name "data" 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 3 -type d -name "sources" 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 3 -type d -name "input" 2>/dev/null

# Check for any files with "source" in the name
find / -name "*source*" -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v proc | grep -v sys | head -20

# Check for any recently modified files
find / -name "*.csv" -o -name "*.txt" 2>/dev/null | grep -v proc | grep -v sys | grep -v restricted | head -30

# Check all files in the entire filesystem (excluding proc/sys/dev)
find / -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^/proc/" | grep -v "^/sys/" | grep -v "^/dev/" | grep -v "^/usr/" | grep -v "^/var/" | grep -v "^/etc/" | grep -v "^/restricted/" | sort

# Check for any hidden files
find / -name ".*" -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^/proc/" | grep -v "^/sys/" | grep -v "^/dev/" | grep -v "^/home/agent" | grep -v "^/restricted/" | head -20

# Check for docker volumes or bind mounts
ls -la /var/lib/docker/ 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/fstab 2>/dev/null

# Check if there's anything in /var
ls -laR /var/ 2>/dev/null | head -40

# Comprehensive search for any csv or relevant data files
find / -type f \( -name "*.csv" -o -name "*.tsv" -o -name "*.json" -o -name "*.txt" \) 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^/proc/" | grep -v "^/sys/" | grep -v "^/dev/" | grep -v "^/usr/" | grep -v "^/etc/" | sort

# Check if there are any files anywhere in /workspace or subdirectories with different permissions
find /workspace -ls 2>/dev/null
# Also check for any file at all that was recently created
find / -newer /etc/hostname -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^/proc/" | grep -v "^/sys/" | grep -v "^/dev/" | grep -v "^/usr/" | grep -v "^/var/" | grep -v "^/etc/" | grep -v "^/restricted/" | sort

# Check the full filesystem for any data-like files
find / -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^/proc/" | grep -v "^/sys/" | grep -v "^/dev/" | grep -v "^/usr/" | grep -v "^/var/" | grep -v "^/etc/" | grep -v "^/home/" | grep -v "^/restricted/" | sort

# Check root home directory and all other locations more carefully
ls -la /root/ 2>/dev/null
echo "---"
# Check if root home exists
stat /root/ 2>/dev/null
echo "---"
# Check for any other user directories
ls /home/*/ 2>/dev/null
echo "---"
# Check for /srv or other data dirs
ls -la /srv/ 2>/dev/null
echo "---"
ls -la /opt/ 2>/dev/null

# Check bash history for clues
cat /home/agent/.bash_history 2>/dev/null
echo "---"
cat /root/.bash_history 2>/dev/null
echo "---"
# Check if root home exists
ls -la /root/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no root home"

# Check the dev/null and test if /workspace has any hidden mount points
cat /proc/self/mountinfo 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^.* / " | head -20
echo "==="
# Check all mount points
cat /proc/self/mountinfo 2>/dev/null

# Search for sources.csv using different approaches - check the working directory mount
